title: Prove a call Gram normal form for dirty Q8 words
body:
## Summary

Prove a simultaneous scalar core and an exact call Gram normal form for normalized dirty register words. Apply it to an exact-length positive-Q8 negative-target criterion and a dependency-free SMT-LIB exporter.

```text
X = paid image columns, Y = paid covector rows, A = YX
core = im X / (im X intersect ker Y)
core dimension = rank A
ordered reduced sequence up to binary GL basis change = A + ordered labels

Q8: binary projectors + all eight formal coefficient equations
    iff the specified negative endpoint exists at that exact length
```

The character yields A cubed = A squared and identifies essential dirty roles with nilpotent size-two blocks. The proof is uniform over finite dimensions; executable fixtures are capped at sixteen roles/calls. The quotient and rank-factorization facts are standard linear algebra. The ordered-call application, strict reduction and exact endpoint criterion are the additions.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3487 separately restricts the image or quotients the common kernel. Both give two roles on the retained eight-call identity fixture. Its three-negative workspace tariff remains open.
  **After:** The simultaneous core uses one role for that same sequence and preserves every ordered paid call. This compares fixed-sequence reductions, not minimum implementation costs. The exact decision criterion removes the workspace/basis choice without solving the tariff.
- Registered standard-library replay passes 5,463 words, 120,896 faithful dirty-input columns, 32,521 call-intertwining checks, 85,392 coefficient quotient equations, 192 direct negative endpoints, all 530 Gram/label candidates through three calls, 8,344 candidate/target valuations and 2,100 independent rank valuations. Three optimized behavioral groups reject actual core, multiplication, independent-action and symbolic-endpoint faults and check boundaries/output collisions.
- Separate Z3 4.15.4 parser checks agree on all 8,344 small valuations and 64 nine-call positive models. Both exploratory seven-call target-shape probes returned unknown after their timeout. No exclusion follows.
- Scoped Ruff and warnings-as-errors pass. At publication commit 2c0cd78964ef363b15e2f4b2675bbd6982ae3ed8, the actual `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` passes all sixteen committed files and canonical ancestry. Both documented Git-free scientific commands and both exact SMT exports pass. All seventeen exported payload/transport files retain their bytes, modes and inodes.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-gram-core
```

[Proof, source-bound receipt, retained predecessor bytes, export commands and limits](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2c0cd78964ef363b15e2f4b2675bbd6982ae3ed8/research/q8-gram-core). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19010794).

Credit Tuafo/PR2900 for image restriction, ywz65/PR2587 for coefficient support and Sylvester, and PR3487 for its common-kernel quotient and two-sided bound. The exact predecessor proof is retained unchanged, with its full attribution. PR3471/3499 retain their finite minima and weighted-frontier credit. No foreign pending commit is declared as canonical ancestry.

The arbitrary-workspace three-negative minimum, native conversion, actual paid caller, full physical invoice, supplier and new kappa remain unclaimed. Exact lengths 3,5,7 are distinct systems; excluding only seven would not exclude five. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The result and replay are confined to one new research package.

**Blast Radius:** package

No selected source, frontier or existing verifier is changed. Hosted scientific replay is not yet claimed.
